text:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 (alert: emb-failure-rate > 8% for 2m). Affected customer: enterprise-cust-123. Triggered at 2027-02-12T08:02:36Z

sarah_oncall: seeing it, jumping in — checking routing & recent config changes.

lee_runtime: I see a routing write at 2027-02-12T07:58:01 from maria_prod (release). Looking at alias table now.

devon_sre: can you dump the alias mapping? quick grep for the embed alias please.

lee_runtime: run: ```redwoodctl routing get --alias embed-standard --region eu-west-1 --json```
Output: ```{
  "alias": "embed-standard",
  "pinned_version": "v2027-03-09-anchor",
  "target_variant": "chat-instruct-3.2.1"
}```

tanya_support: wait that shows chat variant for an embeddings alias? that would explain the 5xxs + schema errors. :eyes:

maria_prod: i pushed the anchor earlier to align chat/instruct versions across regions — must have accidentally pointed embed alias at the same anchor. sorry.

rick_cse: AcmeCorp (enterprise-cust-123) reported "too many errors" to their app team ~08:03. they're on the EU region exclusively.

sarah_oncall: ok immediate mitigation: we need a temporary override to route embed traffic to a compatible model (embed-2.9.0) while we fix the anchor. devon, lee can you apply an emergency patch to routing?

devon_sre: i'll apply a per-tenant route override for enterprise-cust-123 and global alias fallback for embed-standard in eu-west-1. commands:
```bash
# create tenant override
redwoodctl routes create-override --tenant enterprise-cust-123 --route /v1/embeddings --model embed-2.9.0 --region eu-west-1 --reason "emergency fallback for incompatible anchor"
# set alias fallback
redwoodctl routing update --alias embed-standard --region eu-west-1 --fallback-model embed-2.9.0
```

deploy-bot: Started deployment: routing-override-eu-2384123510 by devon_sre. CI checks passed.

lee_runtime: override applied at 2027-02-12T08:06:10Z. updating config store entry now.

devon_sre: confirming traffic shift: sampling logs show embed requests now routed to embed-2.9.0. 5xx rate dropping from 11.2% -> 2.1% in the last 2m.

incident-bot: Alert update: emb-failure-rate cleared in eu-west-1. Incident window so far: 08:02:36Z -> 08:06:20Z (mitigated but still investigating root cause).

maria_prod: full root cause: my deploy script used an environment variable that collapsed alias mappings into the "anchor" object, and the embed alias key got overwritten with the chat variant id. I overlooked a test for variant type mismatch.

tanya_support: customer impact estimate? we need numbers for comms.

lee_runtime: preliminary: enterprise-cust-123 saw 12% of their embedding requests fail between 08:02 and 08:06 (approx 24k requests, ~2.9k failed). Global small % also hit due to regional fallback rules hitting other regions briefly when eu capacity hit error thresholds.

rick_cse: they're asking for an incident summary and ETA for permanent fix. I'll draft a short note once we have rollback plan.

sarah_oncall: permanent fix plan: 1) revert the anchor change (maria) 2) add variant-type validation to the routing write API (lee) 3) add an automated canary that verifies alias->variant compatibility post-deploy (devon) 4) postmortem and customer comms (support + eng). Can we get ETA on revert?

maria_prod: i can revert anchor to previous mapping now. applying revert patch.

deploy-bot: Started rollback: anchor-revert-2384123625 by maria_prod.

lee_runtime: verifying compatibility: adding a quick preflight check in routing-service to fail writes that map embed aliases to non-embed variants. Pushing a hotfix branch now (hotfix/routing-variant-validation).

devon_sre: once rollback finishes we'll keep the emergency override for 30m as a safety net. then remove if metrics stable.

maria_prod: rollback completed at 2027-02-12T08:09:15Z. alias embed-standard now points to embed-3.2.1 (expected).

devon_sre: monitoring: emb 5xx at 08:09 -> 08:15 trending to baseline. removing per-tenant override at 08:25 if no regressions.

incident-bot: Note: create incident ticket INF-2027-1548 and assign severity=P2.

rick_cse: drafted customer note: "We experienced elevated errors for embeddings on EU region between 08:02 and 08:09 UTC. Root cause was a configuration anchor change that incorrectly remapped an embedding alias to a chat variant. We have reverted the anchor and applied a temporary override. We are rolling out a validation fix to prevent recurrence." sending to customer now.

tanya_support: thanks. include apology + offer to review tenant routing config with them.

sarah_oncall: next actions (assign owners): maria -> postmortem writeup (root cause + deploy process fix) due EOD; lee -> PR for routing-service validation + tests; devon -> automation to run alias->variant canary; rick/tanya -> customer follow-up and summary.

maria_prod: ack, starting postmortem draft.

lee_runtime: pushed hotfix branch and a unit test that fails a write when variant types mismatch. will open PR in 20m.

devon_sre: leaving temporary override in place until 08:25; will remove then if SLOs stable.

sarah_oncall: thanks everyone. marking incident as mitigated. create follow-up thread for postmortem when draft is ready. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration: ~7m. Ticket INF-2027-1548 created.

maria_prod: sorry again — will add stricter deploy checks.

rick_cse: customer replied: "appreciate the quick response, please keep us posted on prevention steps." I'll loop in via support-channel.

sarah_oncall: end of thread for paging handoff. follow-ups via INF-2027-1548 and postmortem doc.
